title: Unified Origin of the Radial Acceleration Relation and the Hubble Tension via Entropic Gravity Modification
description: Presents an Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) mechanism in which an entropy-driven modification of the effective gravitational coupling unifies the galaxy-scale Radial Acceleration Relation (RAR) with the cosmological Hubble tension. The paper derives a consistent coupling a_G ≈ 0.1 from both MOND/RAR phenomenology and the H0 discrepancy via a Friedmann-based constraint a_{H0} = 1/2 a_G, predicting H0 ≈ 73.9 km/s/Mpc from galactic dynamics alone within 1.2% of observations.

running_parameter.description: Core Lock running parameter with constant negative beta function along the entropy axis S.

accumulated_phase.description: Entropy-accumulated phase controlling projection of observables; with \Delta S=f_0=1, this reduces to e^S - 1.

entropy_mapping.description: Sigmoid map from redshift to entropy coordinate, modeling structure-formation history (z_trans ≈ 3, \Delta ≈ 0.5).

effective_gravity.description: Entropy-driven modification of the effective gravitational coupling between epochs separated by phase difference \Delta\Phi.

friedmann_constraint.description: From H^2 \propto G_{\mathrm{eff}}\,\rho with fixed \rho, a factor-of-two relation links H0 coupling to the gravity coupling.

mond_mapping.description: Relates MOND interpolation-induced enhancement \mu^{-1} in the RAR transition regime to the EFC coupling a_G.

h0_prediction.description: Predicts the locally inferred H0 from CMB H0 using the EFC coupling and phase gap between CMB and today.

key_results.main_finding: A single entropy-driven coupling a_G ≈ 0.1 inferred from MOND/RAR and the Friedmann relation a_{H0} = 1/2 a_G predicts H0 ≈ 73.9 km/s/Mpc, matching local measurements within 1.2% and unifying the RAR and H0 tension.

sealed_predictions.statement: Meta-analysis of SPARC (and successor) rotation curves will recover an EFC gravity coupling a_G ≈ 0.10 in the RAR transition regime (g_bar/a0 ≈ few), consistent across galaxy types.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Global rotation-curve fits yielding a stable a_G inconsistent with ~0.1 (e.g., consistent with 0 or systematically far from 0.1) across the transition regime.

sealed_predictions.statement: Using a_G inferred from RAR alone and the measured phase gap ΔΦ ≈ 1.71, the relation a_{H0} = 1/2 a_G will predict the local H0 without introducing new free parameters.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Independent determinations of a_G from RAR and ΔΦ from structure-growth proxies that, when combined via a_{H0}=1/2 a_G, fail to reproduce local H0 within observational uncertainties.

kill_criteria: KC1: Robust rotation-curve analyses (e.g., SPARC) show no consistent gravitational enhancement in the RAR transition zone, returning an a_G consistent with zero across systems.
KC2: Empirical determinations of a_G from RAR and from the H0 tension disagree irreconcilably (beyond systematic allowances), eliminating the proposed common value near 0.1.
KC3: The predicted correlation signature d(ln v)/d(ln c) being approximately constant across radii and galaxy surface densities is not observed in high-quality kinematic samples.
epistemic_status: Mathematical prediction compatible with current observations
abstract: Demonstrates that the Hubble tension and RAR arise from the same mechanism: entropy-driven modification of effective gravity. Predicts H₀ ≈ 74 km/s/Mpc from galaxy rotation data, matching observations within 1.2%.
falsification_criteria: a_G from SPARC fits must yield ~0.1
Correlation signature d ln v / d ln c must be constant
